items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Russell Gee; the name appears only in a list of personnel read by the interviewer.

ctx.x: Murray McGrekin. Yeah, he played a solo on something in the studio. We were making the picture, yeah, and we were doing the recording on it.

Yeah. And the music score was Billy Byers by Duke Ellington, and supervised by Billie Beyers, the jazz sequences by Louie Armstrong. The controversy rages as to which musicians are responsible for individual sequences, but Paul Gonsalves Gonzalez and Murray McEachern ghosted McGrekin goes to the two principals. So I guess when Paul played for what? Sidney Poitier? I can't remember the story now. The collected ive personnel includes was Clark Terry, Willie Cook, Cat Anderson, Ray Nance, Ed Mullens, Lawrence Brown,…
